info.title: Comma window control
info.description: Normal Toyota safety mode with stationary Park interlocks. Four windows support up/down/step/timed percentages (estimates). Moonroof slide_open/close_slide/tilt_up/tilt_down directions verified on this ECU. Closing uses 0x20, not the older 0x80 encoding. Closed feedback stops close/lower; no intermediate roof position feedback. Factory motor IO bypasses jam protection. Roof endpoints allow up to twelve seconds, in individual CAN pulses of six seconds maximum. Host watchdog releases every pulse.

servers.description: Fleet Manager port 8082, bearer authenticated for PWA/ESP clients

action.description: Windows: up/down/position/calibrate. Moonroof only: slide_open/close_slide/tilt_up/tilt_down. Roof closing stops on its closed-state signal; intermediate slide/tilt position is not measured.

duration_s.description: Optional timed move; omit for an endpoint. Up/down only.

open_percent.description: position only: 0=closed, 100=open; intermediate targets require calibration and are timed estimates.

confirm_clear.description: Required true for upward window motion and all moonroof motion; factory IO bypasses jam protection.

request_id.description: Deduplicates retries; reuse with different commands is rejected. Results retained for the latest 50 jobs.

get.summary: Read vehicle/window state, calibration and verification

200.description: Status; a partly-open window has no measured opening percentage.

202.description: Accepted; poll /v1/jobs/{id}. Motors are explicitly released on completion, cancellation, stale controls or leaving Park.

400.description: Invalid input, missing clearance assertion or required calibration

409.description: Busy, not parked, stale vehicle state or recovery required

post.summary: Cancel the active job and release motor output

200.description: Stop requested, or no active job
